ingredients: 6 tbsp single cream or full cream milk
steps: Beat the eggs with the cream or milk and a pinch of salt until combined.
Warm a non-stick pan for about a minute. Melt the butter without browning it.
Add the eggs. Wait 20 seconds, then lift and fold them using a wooden spoon.
Pause for 10 seconds, then fold again.
Continue until softly set with some runny patches. Take off the heat and briefly allow residual cooking.
Stir once more and serve immediately.

ingredients: 750g/1lb 10oz young bunched carrots, washed and scrubbed
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
a few sprigs of fresh thyme
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C/400°F/gas 6. Coat carrots in oil, a little vinegar, seasoning, thyme and crushed garlic. Cover a roasting dish tightly with foil and bake for 30 to 40 minutes until tender. Uncover and roast for 10 minutes more to brown.
